excerpt.zh: 我们从一队独立勘探者处截获的通讯表明，他们最近在[precursor_planet.GetName]发现了与远古先驱文明相关的物品。出于迷茫，他们并没有染指[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]，因此他们发现的东西现在应该还在原处。
excerpt.en: Intercepted communications from a group of independent prospectors indicate that they recently found something relating to an ancient Precursor civilization on [precursor_planet.GetName]. Superstition compelled them to leave the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon

scope.zh: 整条故事：五种补充线索途径的触发条件与权重、五个“活动迹象”项目与回收报告、收藏家/出售/赠送三种外交来源及其选项、威逼的随机回应、稀有文物行动；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: triggers and weights of the five clue sources, the five 'Signs of … Activity' projects and recovery reports, the collector/sale/gift diplomatic sources and their options, the coercion random answers, and the minor-artifact action; text read in both languages.

uncertain: The legacy title 'Precursors: Lost Clues' was invented by V3; the story now takes the original title of its entry event precursor.301 ('Precursor Discovery').
When several regular-empire descriptions of precursor.301 are valid at once the engine shows one of them; which one is not predictable from script.

label.en: Five ways to make up a missing clue

note.zh: 301、310、311、314由每五年一次的随机事件抽取（各权重25，对“无事件”75，只计算条件满足者）；320来自稀有文物行动。它们彼此独立，都只对正在进行、尚未集齐线索的五个经典先驱者事件链之一生效。
note.en: 301, 310, 311 and 314 are drawn by the five-year random pulse (weight 25 each vs 75 "nothing", eligible events only); 320 comes from a minor-artifact action. They are independent and only apply to an active, unfinished classic precursor chain.

label.zh: 按正在进行的先驱者择一
label.en: One project for the active precursor

note.zh: switch 按 has_event_chain 选择唯一的项目；一个帝国同一时间只会有一个经典先驱者事件链。
note.en: A switch on has_event_chain picks exactly one project; an empire only ever has one classic precursor chain.

note.zh: random_list 基础权重10/10；舰队实力不如对方或对方也是尚武文化时“拒绝”权重×50，舰队实力占优时“屈服”权重×50。
note.en: random_list base 10/10; refusing ×50 when our fleet is inferior/pathetic or the seller has Warrior Culture, folding ×50 when our fleet is superior/overwhelming.

precursor.301.zh: 五年脉冲：新的先驱者遗址
precursor.301.en: Five-year pulse: a new precursor site

precursor.320.zh: 稀有文物行动：寻找先驱线索
precursor.320.en: Artifact action: seek a precursor clue

texts.zh: 我们从一队独立勘探者处截获的通讯表明，他们最近在[precursor_planet.GetName]发现了与远古先驱文明相关的物品。出于迷茫，他们并没有染指[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]，因此他们发现的东西现在应该还在原处。
texts.en: Intercepted communications from a group of independent prospectors indicate that they recently found something relating to an ancient Precursor civilization on [precursor_planet.GetName]. Superstition compelled them to leave the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon] alone, so whatever they discovered must still be there.

texts.zh: 数艘行经[precursor_planet.GetName]附近的商船在没有互相联系的情况下都报告称：在[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]方向检测到了异常的数据。在对数据进行研究后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的专家认为，这是远古先驱活动造成的现象。
texts.en: Several merchant ships passing in the vicinity of [precursor_planet.GetName] have independently of each other reported anomalous readings coming from the direction of the [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. After studying these readings, experts on [Root.Capital.GetName] believe they may be indicative of ancient Precursor activity.

texts.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]帝国最近发现了一个大型运送不明来源货物的人，抓捕了大量嫌疑人。一位走私小组长为争取宽大处理，为我们提供了[precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的坐标。据称该星球上具有先驱文明的遗留物。
texts.en: Authorities on [Root.Capital.GetName] recently exposed a large smuggling ring, and many arrests have been made. In an attempt to bargain for leniency, one of the smuggler captains gave us the coordinates of a [precursor_planet.GetPlanetMoon] that supposedly contains remnants of an ancient Precursor civilization.

texts.zh: 我方地面部队的几名新兵为了进行生存训练，采用高跳低开方式降落到了[precursor_planet.GetName]。两个月后接应新兵时，有一名新兵报告称发现了许多很久以前就有先驱文明踏足这个星球的证据。
texts.en: Several recruits from our ground forces recently made a HALO insertion onto the surface of [precursor_planet.GetName] as part of a survival training exercise. When the recruits were picked up again after two months, one of them reported several findings indicating that an ancient Precursor civilization had a presence on this world long ago.

texts.zh: 诊断阵列西塔记录到了可能是出现在[precursor_planet.GetName]的一次异常事件。据悉，没有任何[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]单元在此颗未殖民天体附近进行作业。但初步分析表明，在非常遥远的过去，曾有先驱者文明拜访过该地。
texts.en: Diagnostic Array Theta has registered a possible irregularity on [precursor_planet.GetName]. No [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] units are known to be operating in the vicinity of this uninhabited astronomical body, but a preliminary analysis indicates that it may have been visited by a Precursor civilization at some point in the distant past.

texts.zh: 巡逻[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]在进行[precursor_planet.GetName]地表例行检查时，向思维发出警报，称我们控制的空间内出现了一次异常事件。该可能事件的信号与先前观测到的先驱者文明信号一致。
texts.en: Patrol [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] performing a routine surface sweep of [precursor_planet.GetName] have alerted us to an irregularity within our controlled space. Signs of possible activity consistent with a Precursor civilization have been sighted.

tooltips.zh: [precursor_planet.GetName]上有一个新的考古特殊项目可以进行。
tooltips.en: A new archaeological special project is available on [precursor_planet.GetName].

notes.zh: 条件：非AI、开局已超过50年、没有进行中的补充遗物，且有一个尚未集齐线索、可到达其星域的经典先驱者事件链。常规帝国的四种正文在条件相同时随机显示其一；机械与蜂巢各有专属正文。
notes.en: Requires a non-AI empire, more than 50 years elapsed, no artifact already in progress, and an unfinished classic precursor chain whose region is reachable. Regular empires see one of four equally valid flavour texts; machines and hives have their own.

texts.zh: 我们得知，在十分遥远的过去，可能有先驱者曾在[precursor_planet.GetName]上活动。据了解，古老的沃陶姆恒星众的影响范围已经触及到我们所在的这个区域，使得在这个世界的我们能够在探索他们的文明的道路上领先一大步。
texts.en: We have learned that there may have been Precursor activity on [precursor_planet.GetName] at some point in the galactic past. The sphere of influence of the ancient Vultaum Star Assembly is known to have extended to this region of space, making this world a promising lead in our ongoing efforts to learn more about their civilization.

notes.zh: 五个“活动迹象”项目同构：180天，需科研船与科学家；完成后的“文物已回收”报告给对应事件链线索+1，并调用该事件链的母星定位检查（见各先驱者故事）。
notes.en: The five 'Signs of … Activity' projects are identical in form: 180 days, science ship with scientist; the 'Artifact Recovered' report adds one clue to that chain and runs its home-system check (see each precursor story).

texts.zh: 经过对[precursor_planet.GetName]的彻底调查，终于发现了[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]曾经在这里存在的证据。[Root.GetName]的先遣队已经将一个保存相对完好的文物带回飞船。它应该有助于加深我们对这个古代文明的了解。
texts.en: A thorough investigation of [precursor_planet.GetName] has unearthed evidence of a past [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] presence. An away team from the [Root.GetName] has managed to bring a relatively well-preserved artifact back to the ship, which should hopefully increase our knowledge of this ancient civilization.

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]之外进行作业的回收单位成功回收了一件[precursor_planet.GetName]的文物。该文物可追溯到[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]先驱者文明。在对此物品进行彻底的研究过后，我们已将新信息更新至数据库。
texts.en: Retrieval units operating out of the [Root.GetName] have successfully recovered an artifact from [precursor_planet.GetName] whose origins can be traced back to the [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] Precursor civilization. Our databanks are currently being updated with the new information we have gained through the study of this item.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的[controller.GetIndividualNamePluralCap]从[precursor_planet.GetName]成功回收了一件先驱者文物。该文物属于古老的[Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv]文明。对他们的历史的集体知识更进了一步。
texts.en: [controller.GetIndividualNamePluralCap] from the [Root.GetName] have successfully retrieved a Precursor artifact from [precursor_planet.GetName], belonging to the ancient [Root.Owner.GetPrecursorCiv] civilization. Our accumulated knowledge of their history has increased.

texts.zh: [collector_home.GetName]上的一个私人收藏家不知以什么途径得到了一件先驱者文物。该文物应该是源自[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]。尽管政府已经施压，可那位收藏家还是一点都没有要交出文物的意思。
texts.en: A private collector on [collector_home.GetName] has somehow come into ownership of an ancient Precursor artifact believed to be [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] in origin. Despite government pressure, the collector has so far been reluctant to part with it.

label.zh: 只要钱给够，不可能搞不定。

tooltips.zh: 以天文数字的价格购买文物。
tooltips.en: Buy the artifact for an exorbitant sum.

label.zh: 这样的文物应该交给博物馆！

tooltips.zh: 宣称该文物归集体所有，让当地的人员把文物抢过来。
tooltips.en: Declare the artifact to be state property and have it seized by the local authorities.

label.zh: 就让那个收藏家留着吧。

tooltips.en: Leave the artifact in the collector's care.

notes.zh: 每个帝国一次，非格式塔；500能量收购或100影响力征收都会直接给当前事件链线索+1（collector_surrenders_artifact，无单独报告）；也可让收藏家保留。
notes.en: Once per empire, non-gestalt. Buying (500 energy) or seizing (100 influence) adds one clue to the active chain directly (collector_surrenders_artifact, no separate report); the collector may also keep it.

texts.zh:
贵安，[artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]向您发来问候。我方帝国有事务希望与贵帝国进行探讨。

我们知道，贵帝国的考古学家已经对远古[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]文明进行了很长时间的研究。由于该文明曾经的疆域覆盖了如今[Root.GetName]的大部分，那么对该文明进行研究自然也是理所应当的。

不过，他们的疆域也同样延伸到了如今[artifact_seller.GetName]所在的宇域。[artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj]的考古学家已经回收了一些珍贵的文物。如果可以的话，我们希望出售给贵帝国一件我们的文物。
texts.en:
Greetings from [artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]. There is a matter my government wishes to discuss.

We understand that your archaeologists have been studying the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] civilization for quite some time. Understandable, since their territory once covered a large part of what today constitutes the [Root.GetName].

As it happens, their territory also extended into what is now the [artifact_seller.GetName], and [artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeologists have recovered a number of unique artifacts. If you are interested, we would be willing to sell you one of these artifacts.

label.zh: 代价昂贵，但是我们会接受的。

responses.zh: 很好。我们会安排将文物立即运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
responses.en: Excellent. We will make arrangements to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName] at once.

tooltips.zh: 我们从[artifact_seller.GetName]那里购买了先驱者文物。
tooltips.en: We purchase a Precursor artifact from the [artifact_seller.GetName].

responses.zh: 你们讨价还价的技巧真是高超，但是这确实是我们能提供给[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的最低价格了。我们接收你们的提议。
responses.en: You drive a hard bargain, but we would expect nothing less from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We accept your offer.

tooltips.zh: 我们从[artifact_seller.GetName]那里购买了先驱者文物。
tooltips.en: We purchase a Precursor artifact from the [artifact_seller.GetName].

label.zh: 立刻交出文物，否则后果自负。
label.en: Surrender that artifact now or suffer the consequences.

tooltips.zh: 我们试图强迫[artifact_seller.GetName]将他们的先驱者文物交给我们。
tooltips.en: We attempt to coerce the [artifact_seller.GetName] into giving us their Precursor artifact.

notes.zh: 每个帝国一次：一位有通讯、关系中立、境内有该先驱星系的邻国出价。1000能量购买；企业统治可500能量还价；尚武文化可威逼（312/313随机）；也可拒绝。购买或对方屈服都会让线索+1。
notes.en: Once per empire: a neutral neighbour with communications and a system of that precursor offers to sell. 1000 energy; Corporate Dominion can counter at 500; Warrior Culture can threaten (312/313 at random); or decline. Buying or a folding seller adds one clue.

texts.zh: [artifact_seller.GetName]绝不向威胁妥协。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，从今以后我们就是敌人！
texts.en: The [artifact_seller.GetName] does not give in to threats. You have made new enemies this day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

label.en: No artifact: the seller is offended

note.zh: 对方获得“受到威胁”看法修正，不交出文物。
note.en: The seller gains a 'threatened' opinion modifier and keeps the artifact.

texts.zh: 我、我们……为了促进我们两个星际种群之间友好关系的发展，当然十分乐意将[artifact_seller.GetName]赠送给[Root.GetName]。
texts.en: I... we... the [artifact_seller.GetName] will of course gladly donate the artifact to the [Root.GetName], in the interest of fostering amicable relations between our two star nations.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友，你们好呀。

[artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj]近来的一次考古调查发现了一些被认为是[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]先驱者文明留下来的文物。

这些文物现在被陈列于[artifact_giver.Capital.GetName]的一座博物馆内。为了致敬我们两个伟大帝国之间的友谊，[artifact_giver.GetName]想要将其中一件文物捐献给[Root.GetName]。将文物运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]的相关安排已经准备妥当。
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] friends.

A recent [artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeological expedition uncovered several artifacts believed to have originated in the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] Precursor civilization.

The artifacts are currently being displayed in a museum on [artifact_giver.Capital.GetName], but in honor of the friendship between our two great empires, the [artifact_giver.GetName] would like to donate one of the pieces to the [Root.GetName]. Arrangements have already been made to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName].

notes.zh: 每个帝国一次：一位友好、保护或忠诚的邻国（境内有该先驱星系）赠送文物，接受即线索+1。
notes.en: Once per empire: a friendly, protective or loyal neighbour with a system of that precursor donates an artifact; accepting adds one clue.

texts.zh: 对稀有文物的分析让我们获悉，或许在[precursor_planet.GetName]附近有一个先驱者节点。
texts.en: Analysis of the minor artifacts suggests that there may be a Precursor connection on or near [precursor_planet.GetName].

tooltips.zh: [precursor_planet.GetName]上有一个新的考古特殊项目可以进行。
tooltips.en: A new archaeological special project is available on [precursor_planet.GetName].

notes.zh: 稀有文物行动 artifact_precursor_clue：花费500稀有文物，冷却1800天；要求一个尚未集齐线索且星域可到达的经典先驱者事件链。效果与301相同，生成对应的“活动迹象”项目。
notes.en: Minor-artifact action artifact_precursor_clue: 500 minor artifacts, 1800-day cooldown; needs an unfinished classic precursor chain with a reachable region. Same effect as 301: the matching 'Signs of … Activity' project.

summary.text:
# 发现先驱 / Precursor Discovery

- 分类 Category：先驱者 Precursors · 来源 Sources：events/precursor_events.txt:5685–7190；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:485–491；common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt:3448–3577；common/artifact_actions/artifact_actions.txt:843；common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:768；common/scripted_effects/nomads_effects.txt:6753 · DLC：稀有文物行动需《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

这是五个经典先驱者（沃陶姆、尤特、第一联盟、伊拉斯、赛博勒克斯）共用的“补足线索”机制（源码注释 PRECURSOR ARTIFACT CATCH-UP），不属于任何一族。每五年一次的国家脉冲 on_five_year_pulse_country 以随机事件抽取 301、310、311、314（各权重25，对“无事件”75，只计算条件满足者）；320 则来自稀有文物行动“寻找先驱线索”（500稀有文物，冷却1800天）。共同条件：非AI，开局超过50年，拥有一个尚未集齐六份线索的经典先驱者事件链。

A shared "catch-up" mechanism for the five classic precursors (source comment: PRECURSOR ARTIFACT CATCH-UP), not owned by any of them. The five-year country pulse draws 301, 310, 311 or 314 from random events (weight 25 each vs 75 "nothing", eligible events only); 320 comes from the minor-artifact action that seeks a precursor clue (500 minor artifacts, 1800-day cooldown). Common requirements: non-AI, more than 50 years elapsed, an active classic precursor chain still short of six clues.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 301 / 320“发现先驱”：在已勘察、无主、无异常的该先驱星域行星上生成一个“××活动迹象”项目（按正在进行的事件链五选一，180天，科研船+科学家）→ 完成后“××文物已回收”（302–306），线索+1，并调用该族的母星定位检查。
- 310 私人收藏家（每帝国一次，非格式塔）：500能量收购、100影响力征收或任其保留；前两者直接线索+1。
- 311 邻国出售（每帝国一次）：1000能量购买；企业统治可500能量还价；尚武文化可威逼 → 312 拒绝（对方敌视）或 313 屈服交出；或拒绝交易。
- 314 友邦赠送（每帝国一次）：接受即线索+1。

- 301 / 320 "Precursor Discovery": spawns a "Signs of … Activity" project on a surveyed, unowned, anomaly-free planet in that precursor's region (one of five, by the active chain; 180 days, science ship + scientist) → "… Artifact Recovered" (302–306), +1 clue, then that chain's home-system check.
- 310 Private Collector (once, non-gestalt): buy for 500 energy, seize for 100 influence, or let them keep it; the first two add a clue directly.
- 311 a neighbour sells (once): 1000 energy; Corporate Dominion can pay 500; Warrior Culture can threaten → 312 refuses (hostile) or 313 folds; or decline.
- 314 a friendly neighbour's gift (once): accepting adds a clue.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 五种途径相互独立，可在不同脉冲中先后出现；每次脉冲最多抽中一个。所得线索与正常调查报告一样计入六份门槛，第六份时会跳到对应先驱者故事的“母星系位置确认”（外部链接）。
- 312/313 由 random_list 决定（基础10/10，按双方舰队实力或对方是否尚武×50）。
- 拒绝、保留或谈判失败都不会提供线索。

- The five routes are independent and may happen in different pulses; each pulse draws at most one. Their clues count toward the six-clue threshold like ordinary reports; the sixth leads to the precursor's "Home System Located" event (external link).
- 312/313 come from a random_list (base 10/10, ×50 by relative fleet power or the seller's Warrior Culture).
- Declining, letting the collector keep it or a refused threat yields no clue.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 301 常规帝国有四种同条件正文（引擎任选其一），机械智能与蜂巢思维各一种；302–306 也按常规/机械/蜂巢分三种正文。
- 311 的还价与威逼选项分别要求企业统治与尚武文化公民性。
- 游牧帝国（nomads_effects.txt）改为在驿站所在或相邻的先驱星系中寻找地点。

- 301 has four equally valid regular-empire texts (the engine shows one) plus machine and hive versions; 302–306 have regular/machine/hive texts.
- 311's counter-offer and threat need Corporate Dominion and Warrior Culture.
- Nomadic empires (nomads_effects.txt) look for a site in or next to a waystation system instead.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：301–320 全部脚本、五年脉冲随机表、五个 ARTIFACT_FOUND 项目、collector_surrenders_artifact 与 spawn_precursor_anomaly_effect、artifact_precursor_clue；中英文正文已读。
- 修正：V3 的标题“先驱者：遗失的线索”是自拟的，现改用入口事件 precursor.301 的原标题；补充并行组（五种途径）与两个互斥组；明确这些事件不属于沃陶姆或任何单一先驱者（V3 曾把 1–499 误归沃陶姆）。
- 不确定：301 常规正文的选择方式不可从脚本预测。

- Checked: all scripts 301–320, the five-year pulse table, the five ARTIFACT_FOUND projects, collector_surrenders_artifact and spawn_precursor_anomaly_effect, artifact_precursor_clue; both languages read.
- Fixes: V3's invented title "Precursors: Lost Clues" replaced by the original title of entry event precursor.301; parallel set and two exclusive groups added; these events belong to no single precursor (V3 once lumped 1–499 into the Vultaum).
- Uncertain: which of 301's regular texts is shown cannot be predicted from script.
